Clipdip — Third-Party Attributions
====================================

This distribution includes the following third-party software.


FFmpeg
------
Copyright (c) the FFmpeg developers and contributors.
Licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License (LGPL) version 2.1
or, at your option, any later version.

The FFmpeg binary included here is an "essentials" build that contains
only LGPL-licensed components (no GPL libraries are linked). In
accordance with the LGPL:

  - You may use, copy, and distribute this software under the terms of
    the LGPL 2.1+.
  - The complete corresponding source code for this FFmpeg build is
    available at:
      https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
    You may also obtain it by writing to:
      Clipdip maintainers <fabiansilbermann1@gmail.com>
  - You are free to replace the bundled ffmpeg.exe with your own LGPL
    build. Clipdip will prefer a sibling ffmpeg.exe next to clipdip.exe,
    then fall back to ffmpeg on your PATH, so no configuration change is
    needed.

Full license text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.html
